system.description:
Beginning at 14th level, you gain immunity to the damage type dealt by your Sanguine Transference while you are frenzied.

Additionally, when you would fall into your Frenzy, the Narrator immediately rolls [[/r 1d6]]. On a result of 1, nothing happens and your Frenzy functions as normal. On a result of 2–6, you are under the effects of the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.ap6klied8mqbclvn]{Enlarge/Reduce}. You are enlarged on a result of 2–5 and reduced on a result of 6, and you assume all of the benefits or penalties as conferred by the spell.

At the top of each subsequent round, roll [[/r 1d4]]. On a result of 1–3 you remain at the Size that you were. On a result of a 4, you are instead under the effects of a 4th-level enlarge/reduce spell and cease to grow or reduce in size for the duration of this effect.

This effect lasts a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier or until your Frenzy ends as normal.
